headlines.title: FedEx (FDX) Stock Trades Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
headlines.summary: FedEx has delivered a strong multiyear run, and with the stock recently closing at US$318.84, the live question for investors is whether that share price is properly grounded in the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 73.4%, which puts real weight on whether the current valuation still lines up with the cash flows that underpin it.

headlines.title: FedEx (FDX) Lifts 2026 Outlook On Earnings As Fair Value Stays In Focus
headlines.summary: FedEx raises 2026 outlook after mixed quarterly earnings FedEx (FDX) lifted its full year 2026 earnings guidance after reporting higher sales for the third quarter and the four month period ended September 30, a combination that sharpened investor focus on the stock. FedEx shares closed at US$318.84 after a 3.47% 1 day share price return, capping a 9.30% 30 day gain that follows raised 2026 earnings guidance and fresh board appointments. headlines.title: Why Is FedEx (FDX) Bringing In Jamere Jackson As CFO?
headlines.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) appointed Jamere Jackson as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Jackson brings prior CFO experience from several large publicly traded companies across different sectors. He is expected to oversee FedEx's global finance organization, including corporate finance, treasury, tax, and investor relations functions. FedEx's choice of Jamere Jackson as CFO is only one piece of the broader investment story around the business.

description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
